## 6b. The learned nodes (step 2 of the learned causal map)

Each node uses only the causal-map links into it. A link's strength is how much worse the node predicts matches it never saw without that link's features (refit without them, same folds); supported when the gain is more than twice its spread across folds, rejected when dropping it helps by more than that, otherwise not clear yet.

## 7. The usual play

Each choice against the most common one in that kind of decision, in win-chance points over the decision's window, adjusted for the situation, with a 90% range from resampling whole matches. CLEAR = the range excludes 0. Win chance comes from a model that never saw the match. The same comparison over the 30 s BEFORE the decision is a placebo test: a choice can't cause what came before it, so a clear difference there means the effect is partly who makes that choice.

Denning's four questions, each from the batch's matches. **Why, in short**: Crew split Prot+7 Monk+Mesmer into BcS's base; at 15:08 the pit had 3 attackers against 0 defenders (0 of them healers), with 5 of BcS elsewhere; 3 of BcS were dead at the time (Air Ele 14:29, Fire Ele 14:49, 8 Monk 14:53); the Air Ele died at 14:29 (push side, numbers [4, 4]) because no prot landed in time (0 of 0 landed; 8 Monk Guardian, 8 Monk Shielding Hands ready and unused), knocked down 1 times with no knockdown immunity up, the enemy hit unusually hard (67.8 per second); the Fire Ele died at 14:49 (backside, numbers [5, 4]) because no prot landed in time (0 of 0 landed; 8 Monk Guardian, 8 Monk Shielding Hands ready and unused), knocked down 1 times with no knockdown immunity up, the enemy hit unusually hard (75.2 per second); how the game got there: deaths: 1 of BcS died 14:29 (14:29) -> BcS's Air Ele isolated (14:28) -> BcS lost knight (15:11).

**How it got there** (the chain of game states, earliest first; traced back to 14:00, the last reset or 3 minutes before; win = the held-out win model's change over each link):
1. 14:19: **deaths: 1 of BcS died 14:29** (win -22.9 points) -> led to step 3
   - 14:29 Air Ele died (push side, numbers [4, 4]): no prot landed in time (0 of 0 landed; 8 Monk Guardian, 8 Monk Shielding Hands ready and unused); knocked down 1 times with no knockdown immunity up; the enemy hit unusually hard (67.8 per second); its own team's damage was low (16.9 per second)
   - when the fight started: main 4v4, alive 8v8, flag lead +71 s, stand BcS
2. 14:20: **BcS's Air Ele isolated** (ongoing state) -> led to step 1
   - Air Ele away from its main group from 14:20 (mostly push side 10 s)
3. 14:51: **BcS lost knight** (win -36.9 points) (the result)
   - pit at 15:11: 3 attackers against 0 defenders (0 healers)
   - 3 of BcS dead (Air Ele 14:29, Fire Ele 14:49, 8 Monk 14:53)
   - away from base: Ritualist, AoB Derv, Mesmer, Prot, 7 Monk

**Where a fix would have mattered most** (measured, in win points):
- step 1: power play at 14:31 (main 5v4): pushed, to the spawn instead of pushed, fell back: about +8.7 win points (usual.py: measured choice effect against the choice made; not clear yet)
- step 1: enemy pickup at 14:04 (main 4v4): held, advanced instead of already running, advanced: about +5.8 win points (usual.py: measured choice effect against the choice made; clear)

**How it could have been prevented (measured)**

- Further back: with 3 of BcS dead, more defenders were not available; the fixes along the chain are priced above.
- First defender: 0 s after it entered the base; every stored split into a base: median 8 s before it entered the base, quickest fifth 34 s before it entered the base or sooner (350 splits). Denning: about 15 s is on time, 60 s is late.
- The split was answered on time, so the loss came from what the defence did once there (below), not from a late answer.
- NPC-loss node at 15:08 (AUC 0.844 on unseen matches against 0.752 for attackers and defenders alone): 3 attackers (0 healers) against 0 defenders (0 healers), 5 of BcS elsewhere; read 83.5% to lose an NPC; read again with
  - one more defender: 72.3% (-11.2 points; at this loss's measured cost of -36.9 win points, about +4.1 expected; at a typical NPC loss's -2.4, +0.3)
  - one more defender, a healer: 51.4% (-32.1 points; at this loss's measured cost of -36.9 win points, about +11.8 expected; at a typical NPC loss's -2.4, +0.8)
  - two more defenders: 74.0% (-9.5 points; at this loss's measured cost of -36.9 win points, about +3.5 expected; at a typical NPC loss's -2.4, +0.2)
  - healing on the NPCs (as much as the attackers' damage in 5 s): 77.9% (-5.6 points; at this loss's measured cost of -36.9 win points, about +2.1 expected; at a typical NPC loss's -2.4, +0.1)

**Confidence**: medium (one measurement supports it).
